provider: Farcaster hubs / Snapchain — storage RENT, actively metered

free_tier.stated: Storage is allocated in integer units per fid and must be BOUGHT from the Storage Registry contract on Optimism (0x00000000fcCe7f938e7aE6D3c335bD6a1a7c593D). Each CRDT specifies messages-per-unit, so the unit is a message count, not bytes.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: N/a. Hubs replicate messages, media is a URL in the cast body pointing at an external host (often Cloudflare Images / imgur).

tooling: gRPC hub API (submitMessage); `@farcaster/hub-nodejs`. Storage must be purchased on-chain before a message is accepted.
chaining: None. Media is never stored by the protocol. A cast embed is a plain URL. Farcaster is a message log with paid rent, not a file store.
limits_note: per-object-cap not applicable; the binding limit is storage units paid for on Optimism plus per-CRDT message-count accounting. Free tier = whatever 1 storage unit covers (a few hundred casts).

reliability_note: Storage capacity is metered through a paid rent model. The Snapchain architecture preserves this storage rent structure.
